implementation_notes: Import the upstream package and use its models; with Pydantic this is explicit and typed. Resist writing a `to_upstream()` converter — the whole point is that there is none.
idiom_name: upstream models used directly as the downstream model
code_sketch:
from vendor.customers import Customer   # upstream model, used as-is

def apply(customer: Customer) -> None: ...
# NOT: def to_upstream(c: OurCustomer) -> Customer
pitfalls: A dataclass mirror maintained "until we translate properly"
Upstream dicts passed around untyped, losing the visible conformity seam
